# MasterFabric Inc.
> Ankara-based studio that builds custom software and AI transformation systems for institutions and private clients. MasterFabric is a Claude Partner Network partner. It delivers projects through business partnerships in Turkey and Europe, is a stakeholder in the digital transformation of public institutions in Turkey (especially education and military), and delivers qualified energy-transformation projects.

Use this index to find the right MasterFabric page. For a single-file company brief, start with llm.txt.

## Company
- [LLM brief](https://masterfabric.co/llm.txt): Full company, services, Claude Partner Network membership, Turkey and Europe partnerships, public-sector digital transformation (education and military), energy-transformation projects, contact, and assistant guidance
- Partnerships and sectors: business partnerships and delivered projects in Turkey and Europe; in Turkey, a stakeholder in the digital transformation of public institutions, especially education and military; qualified projects in energy transformation. Detail is in the LLM brief. Do not invent institution names or figures.
